_comment: Every server we run, one entry each. CI builds dist/instances/<id>.zip for each one (a Prism Launcher instance that updates itself and joins the server). status: public (anyone), beta (testers only: set /aotrpg access mode beta on that server), private (friends: hand the zip out yourself; also gate it on the server). pack: the packwiz folder in this repo. address: what the launcher joins; on Hamachi that's the host's Hamachi IPv4 and port.
